title: Red panda holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- red panda body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#c1401f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='76' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#e8a06a'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M26 78 Q10 74 12 58 Q14 44 28 46 Q34 52 30 64 Z' fill='#b23a1c'/>
  <path d='M23 70 Q15 66 18 57 Q21 50 28 52' fill='none' stroke='#7a2a14' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='22' fill='#c1401f'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='7' fill='#c1401f'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='7' fill='#c1401f'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#f0d8c0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='22' r='3.5' fill='#f0d8c0'/>
  <!-- face white patches -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='42' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#f5e2d0'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='42' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#f5e2d0'/>
  <!-- inner face -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='46' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f5e2d0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2a1410'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='40' r='3.5' fill='#2a1410'/>
  <circle cx='42.2' cy='38.8' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.2' cy='38.8' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='3.5' ry='2.6' fill='#2a1410'/>
  <path d='M50 49.5 L50 52 M50 52 Q46 55 44 52 M50 52 Q54 55 56 52' fill='none' stroke='#2a1410' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms around heart -->
  <path d='M32 68 Q34 58 44 60' fill='none' stroke='#a83318' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 68 Q66 58 56 60' fill='none' stroke='#a83318' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d='M50 84 C38 74 34 66 40 60 C44 56 49 58 50 62 C51 58 56 56 60 60 C66 66 62 74 50 84 Z' fill='#ff3b6b'/>
  <path d='M44 64 Q46 61 49 63' fill='none' stroke='#ff9db4' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
